core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khamees is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Thursday; the fifth day”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khamees corresponds to the Arabic form خميس (Arabic root خ م س (kh-m-s); خَمِيس (Khamīs)). Its core sense is thursday; the fifth day. Khamees is Arabic خَمِيس (Khamīs) 'Thursday; the fifth day', from the root خ م س (kh-m-s). The source gloss 'Five' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as khamis.
